title: The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, First Schedule, Part I: classification of offences under the Indian Penal Code
source_note: India Code consolidated text of the CrPC 1973 (Legislative Department file A1974-02, PDF of 24 Feb 2020) as hosted on the Government of India S3WaaS CDN; the indiacode.nic.in bitstreams answered HTTP 504 on 2026-11-13

fields.max_punishment: heaviest punishment named in the punishment cell: 'death', 'life imprisonment', 'N years' / 'N months' / 'N days' / 'N hours', or 'fine'; with several sub-rows the heaviest of them; null when any sub-row's cell is relative ('Same as for offence abetted') or empty
fields.cognisable / bailable: true/false only when every sub-row reads the same; null when sub-rows differ, a cell is conditional ('According as ...', 'Cognizable if ...') or a 'Ditto' cannot be resolved; the sub-rows keep the printed text
fields.offence / punishment / triable_by: cell text; several sub-rows joined with ' | ', 'Ditto' replaced by the cell it repeats
fields.ditto_from_amended_entry: columns where a 'Ditto' repeats a cell of an entry an amending Act inserted or substituted
